findings.message: The case claims a warehouse_operator can successfully approve an order, but the supplied requirement authorizes approval only for sales_manager; the intended role or expected authorization behavior must be supplied instead of inferred.
evidence: TC-AUTH-001.expected_outcome=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
REQ-AUTH-001.text=Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.
